findings: Style note only: the closing line "You will know it went out when the post opens on the platform from its link" relies on a link that the filled-in evidence supplies for real accounts; the help text does not say where the link appears, so the reply should keep relying on the evidence for it.

Style note only: step 3 "Any post that failed is also listed with its error details" is supported by "Failed posts also appear at my.blotato.com/failed with the error details" and by Posts > Failed; the reply never tells the customer to send a post again, so it cannot make things worse.

Checked {evidence} filled with the example (2 went out, 3 failed, 2 scheduled, with a stated 7-day window): "Here is what your account shows: In the last 7 days, ..." reads correctly, and the stated window keeps a customer from concluding an older post is missing.
